description: Defines the SettingsDelegate class which manages user, system, and network settings delegates, handles app event notifications, and manages lifecycle of these delegates.

classes.name: SettingsDelegate
classes.description: Manages app settings delegates, handles app event notifications, and provides access to delegate instances.

methods.name: HandleAppEventNotifier
methods.description: Handles app event notifications, passing them to registered delegates and logging errors.

methods.name: setShell
methods.description: Initializes delegate instances with the provided shell.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Resets delegate shared pointers, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: getSystemDelegate
methods.description: Returns the shared pointer to the SystemDelegate.

methods.name: getUserSettings
methods.description: Returns the shared pointer to the UserSettingsDelegate.

methods.name: getNetworkDelegate
methods.description: Returns the shared pointer to the NetworkDelegate.
